description: This file defines a React component named LinkedItemBubble that renders a UI element for displaying and interacting with linked items within the application. It manages focus, click, and keyboard events, displays icons and titles for items, and handles unlink actions.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Sets the focus to this item if it's not already focused and shows the unlink button.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles removing focus and hiding the unlink button when the component loses focus.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the component, activating the linked item if appropriate.

methods.name: onUnlinkClick
methods.description: Triggers unlinking of the item upon clicking the unlink button.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation and actions such as backspace, left, and right arrow keys.
